subject: BrightConf attendee credit split & delivery timeline
messages:
From: Lindsey Harper <lindsey@brightconf.co>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightConf Sponsorships <sponsorships@brightconf.co>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credit allocation for BrightConf workshop attendees

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for chatting on Tuesday. Quick ask from the sponsorship side: we have 150 attendees registered for the hands-on workshop slot and the marketing team would like to offer each attendee a Redwood trial credit they can redeem post-event. Can Redwood provide 150 one-time promo codes worth $100 in trial credits each (redeemable for 90 days)? Ideal delivery date for the codes would be no later than Sep 14 so we can include them in the post-event email.

A few logistics:
- We need the codes to be single-use per email address.
- We want a landing page we can link to for redemption and basic instructions.
- Can you confirm if codes can be restricted to new accounts only or if existing attendees can use them too?

I can share the attendee CSV if that helps. Also attaching the sponsorship packet with timing.

Best,
Lindsey Harper
Sponsorships Lead, BrightConf

Attachment: sponsorship_packet.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit allocation for BrightConf workshop attendees

Hi Lindsey —

Thanks — we can support this. A few clarifying Qs so we scope correctly:

1) Redemption rules: do you want codes limited to brand-new Redwood accounts only, or are returning registrants allowed? If new-only, we can enforce on the back end.
2) Expiry: 90 days is straightforward. Confirming you want one-time single-use codes tied to an email.
3) Distribution: will BrightConf email the codes directly to attendees or should Redwood host the redemption page and we push the codes after verifying the attendee list?
4) Addendum: if you want the credits treated as a sponsor deliverable we typically add a short sponsorship addendum to the contract (DocuSign) that lists quantity/expiration/liability.

Cc'ing Karthik for budget/finance tagging and Ben for ops + delivery manifest. We can draft the promo terms and generate the code manifest once we confirm rules.

Proposed next steps: Karthik to confirm allocation split and charge code; Ben to confirm manifest format and delivery pipeline; I'll send a confirmation to you with final timeline and DocuSign link.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova

Sofia / Ben —

Reviewed the ask. Marketing budget looks fine for a one-off promo allocation under the events line item. Suggested allocation:
- 150 total codes, $100 equivalent each
- Split: 100 codes for live workshop distribution, 50 codes reserved for on-demand registrants / late converts
- Expiry: 90 days from activation
- Redemption rule: limit to one code per account email; allow existing accounts but flag redemptions that look like trials so we can track ROI separately

Please mark GL code 5201-MKT-2026 for charge. Finance will need the sponsorship addendum (signed) and the final manifest CSV for reconciliation.

If legal wants to tighten to new-only, we'll have to withhold the 50 reserved codes until we have T&C final.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Growth Ops | Redwood Inference
